Questions, answered.

What is the best corporate landscaping company in Bengaluru?

Star Gardens is a Bengaluru landscaping company established in 2009. It grows its own plants across 70 acres of nurseries and has delivered offices at Manyata Tech Park, Embassy Golf Links Domlur and Richmond Road.

Do you offer office plants on rent in Bengaluru?

Yes. We offer office plant subscriptions and event or seminar rentals, as well as capex purchase models.

What is a plant AMC?

An Annual Maintenance Contract covers end-to-end servicing, plant health care and replacements for new and existing landscapes. We serve 175+ clients.

Which cities does Star Gardens serve?

Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune.

Do you build indoor vertical gardens for offices?

Yes. We install interior and exterior vertical gardens using engineered systems built for clean execution and long-term plant health.
